description: This file defines the SimpleQueueCacheCursor class which implements the IQueueCacheCursor interface. It manages iteration over a simple queue cache for streaming data in Orleans, providing methods for moving through cache items, retrieving current items, and handling stream-specific logic.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCacheCursor
classes.description: A cursor for iterating over a simple queue cache in Orleans streaming, managing stream positions, and providing access to cache items.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Returns the current batch container in the cache with exception state.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the cursor to the next message in the cache that belongs to the stream.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the cursor position based on a given stream sequence token.

methods.name: RecordDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Marks the current cache element as having a delivery failure.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the cursor and cleans up resources.
